tex: int_0^inf (x+sqrt(x^2+4beta^2))^(2nu)/sqrt(x^3+4beta^2 x) e^(-mu x) dx = sqrt(mu pi^3)/(2^(2nu+3/2) beta^(2nu)) [J_{nu+1/4}(beta mu) Y_{nu-1/4}(beta mu) - J_{nu-1/4}(beta mu) Y_{nu+1/4}(beta mu)]
note: scaling x = beta t gives lhs ~ beta^(2nu-1/2) F(beta mu) but printed rhs ~ beta^(-2nu-1/2) G(beta mu); the printed exponent of the integrand or of beta may be wrong (reading itself is clear)
